Since it is not my main crop and the land is not mine, I will put my manure from the goats on it instead of buying fertilizer which is too expensive now. I will use seed I saved myself, and my wife and children will help me work it. Chikwawa is dry but I cannot afford to irrigate, so I will rely on the rains and weed by hand.
